message.text:
Tracing the CreateMemo call chain from the frontend hook through the client. The frontend hook is `useCreateMemo` in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`. The client is `web/src/connect.ts` (`memoServiceClient`).

Proto RPC: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`CreateMemo`). Handler: `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo`). Store method: `store/memo.go` (`Store.CreateMemo`). Dialect driver: `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (or postgres/mysql).

args.command: grep -n "export function useCreateMemo\|createMemo\|rpc CreateMemo\|func (s \*APIV1Service) CreateMemo\|func (s \*Store) CreateMemo\|func (d \*DB) CreateMemo" /bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts /bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts /bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go /bench/repo/store/memo.go /bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go

message.text: connect.ts exports the memoServiceClient via createClient(MemoService). The grep missed the actual createMemo definition because that file only contains the client export. The answer format requires one file path per line.

`useCreateMemo` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo` (`web/src/connect.ts`). That is `MemoService.CreateMemo` in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`, handled by `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`, then `Store.CreateMemo`, then `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` (INSERT). Connect wrapping is in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`. MySQL/Postgres equivalents are `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`.
